identity.description: An attacker uses a RunOnce registry entry to execute a malicious payload, leveraging a suspicious parent process. Cortex should detect the abnormal parent-child process relationship and registry modification.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Suspicious RunOnce Parent Process
biocs.description: Detects execution of a process from a RunOnce registry key with an unexpected parent process
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'explorer.exe' and action_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'RunOnce'

abiocs.name: RunOnce Execution with Suspicious Parent
abiocs.description: Detects execution via RunOnce registry with parent process that is not typically associated with such activity
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'explorer.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'RunOnce'

xql_queries.name: RunOnce Registry Modifications
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.REGISTRY and action_file_path contains 'RunOnce'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'reg.exe'
